'''Business and economy'''
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]]
**The U.S. [[Federal Aviation Administration]] clears [[Boeing]]'s [[Boeing 737 MAX|737 MAX]] to fly again, provided that all planes receive modifications to their software and wiring and that all pilots receive additional training. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-54981658 (BBC News)]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]]
**[[Norwegian Air Shuttle]] files for [[bankruptcy protection]] in [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] for two subsidiaries: [[Norwegian Air International]] and Arctic Aviation Assets as part of a restructuring of the business due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/wires/20201118-low-cost-norwegian-air-shuttle-files-bankruptcy-protection (RFI)]
*[[Fitch Ratings]] downgrades [[Zambia]]'s [[government debt]] to RD (restricted [[Default (finance)|default]]) after the country failed to pay a [[Eurobond (external bond)|Eurobond]] coupon on Friday. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSL8N2I425T (Reuters)] [https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/zambia-technically-default-debt-non-183634140.html (AFP via Yahoo! Finance)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
******[[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] stated that [[New York City Department of Education|public schools]] across [[New York City]] will temporarily close after the 7-day average positivity rate reaches 3%. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/york-city-schools-close-city-fights-virus-74281068 (ABC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
*****[[Columbus Public Health|Columbus Health Commissioner]] Dr. Mysheika Roberts and [[Franklin County, Ohio]] Health Commissioner Joe Mazzola issue [[stay-at-home order|stay-at-home]] advisories for residents of [[Columbus, Ohio|Columbus]] and [[Franklin County, Ohio|Franklin County]]. People living in these areas are also advised to avoid travelling in and out of the [[Ohio|state]]. [https://www.wane.com/community/health/coronavirus/ohio-capital-city-issues-stay-at-home-order-to-slow-virus/ (WANE-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
*****[[Pennsylvania]] reports a new single-day record of 6,339 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of cases in the state to 281,852. [https://www.wkbn.com/news/coronavirus/pennsylvania-sets-new-record-for-daily-cases-of-covid-19/ (WKBN-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
*****[[Wisconsin]] reports a record of 7,989 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of cases in the state to 331,837. [https://www.wbay.com/2020/11/18/wisconsin-nears-8000-confirmed-coronavirus-cases-setting-new-one-day-record/ (WBAY-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
*****[[Minnesota]] Governor [[Tim Walz]] imposes several new restrictions on businesses and indoor gatherings in response to a surge in new cases. It begins on November 20 and lasts for four weeks. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/governor-walz-press-conference-covid-restrictions-minnesota-live-stream-today-2020-11-18/ (CBS News)] 
****The number of confirmed deaths in the [[United States]] reaches 250,000. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/u-s-surpasses-250-000-coronavirus-deaths-virus-mortality-rate-n1248109 (NBC News)]
****The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] reported a record high number of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases with 1,314 new cases on Tuesday, according to data from the [[United States Department of Defense|Department of Defense]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/18/politics/us-military-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]]
*****[[British Columbia]] reports a record 762 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the province's total number of cases to 24,423. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7470999/bc-coronavirus-update-november-18/ (Global News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a new single-day record of 493 new cases, surpassing the previous record set in August and bringing the cumulative number of cases in the [[Prefectures of Japan|prefecture]] to over 35,000. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20201118/p2g/00m/0na/079000c (''The Mainichi Shimbun'')]
****Nationwide, 2,203 new cases are reported in [[Japan]]. It is the first time that the country has reported more than 2,000 cases since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/11/a61cd086b159-tokyo-planning-to-raise-virus-alert-to-highest-level-amid-surge.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****The number of patients who recovered from COVID-19 in [[Indonesia]] exceeds 400,000. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5260387/kasus-sembuh-virus-corona-indonesia-tembus-400-ribu-ini-sebarannya (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a record 13,421 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the nationwide cumulative total to 801,894 cases. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/amp/coronavirus/2020/11/18/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-Iran-reports-record-daily-increase-with-13-421-new-COVID-19-cases (Al-Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] reports a record 7,933 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide cumulative total to 163,926 cases. [https://en.royanews.tv/breaking-news/364 (Roya News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] surpasses 50,000 total confirmed cases of COVID-19. [https://www.theedgemarkets.com/article/malaysias-new-covid19-cases-drop-660-four-deaths-and-eight-new-clusters-reported (The Edge Markets MY)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****The [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]] reports 313 new cases in [[South Korea]] in the past 24 hours, surpassing 300 for the first time. It is also the highest single-day figure since August 29, taking the nationwide total to 29,311 cases. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201118002251320?section=news (Yonhap News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****[[State of Palestine|Palestine]] reports a record 1,268 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, half of them in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], as officials in both the [[Palestinian Authority]] and [[Hamas]] resist calls to impose a second general lockdown. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/gaza-sees-covid-cases-surge-with-nearly-1-in-4-tests-returning-positive/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****Beginning December 1, [[Taiwan]] will require almost all visitors to have negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 tests]] before arriving in the country due to an increase in imported cases. The [[Government of the Republic of China|government]] will also increase the number of places where people must wear masks. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/having-been-successful-in-covid-19-prevention-taiwan-now-tightens-rules-to-curb (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Cluster 5]]
*****[[Minister for Food, Agriculture and Fisheries (Denmark)|Danish Agriculture Minister]] [[Mogens Jensen (politician)]] resigns following criticism of illegal government order to cull 15-17 million [[mink]]s after the discovery of a mutated version of the coronavirus at some of the [[Denmark|country]]'s [[Fur farming|mink farm]]s. [https://www.euronews.com/2020/11/18/coronavirus-denmark-s-agriculture-minister-resigns-over-illegal-order-to-cull-mink (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 753 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, the highest single-day total since April 3, bringing the nationwide death toll to 47,217. [https://www.corriere.it/salute/20_novembre_18/coronavirus-italia-bollettino-oggi-18-novembre-34283-nuovi-casi-753-morti-bfbf1ca8-2991-11eb-884f-3aae855c458a.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] surpasses 2,000 total deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/covid-19-death-toll-exceeds-2-000-in-the-state-after-12-more-fatalities-1.4412678 (''The Irish Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports a record of 603 new fatalities in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 11,451. [https://www.rmf24.pl/raporty/raport-koronawirus-z-chin/polska/news-rekordowo-duzo-zgonow-nowe-dane-resortu-zdrowia-ws-koronawir,nId,4862567 (RMF 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 456 new fatalities in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 34,387. In addition, a record 25,179 recoveries are reported, outnumbering new cases for the first time since September 16. [https://www.vedomosti.ru/society/articles/2020/11/18/847368-rossii-sutki-viyavili-novih-sluchaev-koronavirusa (''Vedomosti'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/russia-sees-new-record-in-covid-19-deaths-recoveries/2047915 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Attorney General of Spain|Attorney General]] [[Dolores Delgado]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/politica/20201118/dolores-delgado-fiscala-general-del-estado-infectada-de-coronavirus-8210241 (''El Peridico'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] surpasses 10,000 total deaths from COVID-19 after a record 256 new fatalities are reported in the past 24 hours. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-in-ukraine-12496-new-cases-256-new-deaths-296818-active-cases.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
****[[Premier of South Australia|South Australian Premier]] [[Steven Marshall]] announces a six-day "circuit breaker" lockdown across the [[South Australia|state]] beginning at midnight due to a growing number of COVID-19 cases in [[Adelaide]]. Unlike previous lockdowns in [[Australia]], outside exercise and takeaway food will be prohibited. The lockdown will be followed by eight days of "lesser restrictions". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-54983104 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa]]	
****Prime Minister [[Tuilaepa Aiono Sailele Malielegaoi]] confirms the first case of [[COVID-19]] in the country from a sailor who returned from [[Auckland]], [[New Zealand]]. Malielegaoi said the sailor tested positive Wednesday night but that a second confirmation test from this morning was negative. He added that they were concerned that the man could be contagious, though he is in isolation. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/430952/samoa-records-first-positive-covid-test-result (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
****[[Government of Zimbabwe|Authorities]] close a [[boarding school]] in [[Matabeleland North Province]] after at least 100 students tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/africa/2020-11-18-zimbabwe-shuts-school-after-100-students-test-positive-for-covid-19/ (SowetanLIVE)]
***The total number of confirmed cases in [[Africa]] surpasses two million. [[South Africa]] remains the continent's highest number of reported COVID-19 cases at over 750,000. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-africa/coronavirus-cases-in-africa-surpass-the-2-million-mark-reuters-tally-idUSKBN27Y2CZ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Malaysia]]n [[Minister of Energy, Science, Technology, Environment and Climate Change (Malaysia)|Science, Technology and Innovation Minister]] [[Khairy Jamaluddin]] signed an agreement with his [[China|Chinese]] [[Ministry of Science and Technology (China)|counterpart]] [[Wang Zhigang]] to cooperate on the development of a safe and efficacious [[vaccine]], as part of efforts to combat the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2020/11/18/malaysia-and-china-sign-pact-over-covid-19-vaccine (''The Star'')]
***[[Pfizer]] formally ends its vaccine trial with a 95% success rate and will submit a regulatory approval "within days". [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/pfizer-biontech-seek-covid-19-vaccine-approval-within-days-trial-n1248079 (NBC News)]
*[[Kivu Ebola epidemic#2020 Équateur Province outbreak and other health problems|2020 Équateur Province Ebola outbreak]]
**The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] declares the end of an almost six-month long [[List of Ebola outbreaks|Ebola outbreak]] in the [[Province of Équateur|Équateur Province]]. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202011180348.html (AllAfrica.com)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**[[Iran]] says that it will return to the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]], better known as the "Iran Deal", if [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] lifts sanctions imposed by [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/iran-nuclear-deal-joe-biden-donald-trump-sanctions-iaea-uranium-enrichment-centrifuges/?ftag=CNM-00-10aab7e (CBS News)]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions against the [[Mostazafan Foundation]], a foundation controlled by [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]], over alleged human rights abuses. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2020/11/18/us-slaps-iran-related-sanctions-on-khamenei-linked-foundation (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
**Three [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] members of the [[Michigan House of Representatives]] have introduced a resolution calling for the impeachment of Governor [[Gretchen Whitmer]] over her new mitigation measures against the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] in the state. Other members of the [[Michigan Republican Party|Michigan Republicans]], including high-ranking members of the Michigan House, criticize the resolution. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-faces-possible-impeachment-proceedings-for-corrupt-conduct (Fox News)]
*Taiwan's broadcast regulator denies the renewal of the broadcast license of [[CTi News]] channel, citing alleged interference by its major shareholder [[Tsai Eng-meng]]. This is the first time ever that Taiwan shuts down a television news channel. The opposition party [[Kuomintang]] calls it an attack on press freedom. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/taiwan-cti-cable-shut-down-china-tycoon-tsai-eng-meng-13585436 (CNA)]
*[[Politics of Peru]]
**[[Violeta Bermúdez]] becomes the new [[Prime Minister of Peru]]. [https://andina.pe/agencia/noticia-violeta-bermudez-jura-como-presidenta-del-consejo-ministros-821953.aspx (Andina)]
